description: Election Commission - Declare that A. A. Akbar as a member of the Katthankudy Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Kattankudy Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for replacing a resigned member, including the nomination procedure by a recognized political party and the formal declaration by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under election-related administrative matters, specifically Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations.
